question: Which comedy power couple just quietly split after 18 years?
story: One of the biggest couples in comedy just quietly ended their marriage after eighteen years, and almost nobody noticed. Tom Segura and Christina P, the pair behind the massive podcast Your Mom's House, have separated, according to TMZ. If you ever listened to their show, you basically grew up hearing about their life together, which is what makes this one hit so hard. They actually split a few months ago, but kept it completely private while still running their comedy empire side by side. Here is the twist. Sources say there is no scandal at all. The separation was totally amicable, and the two are reportedly in a good place, focused on raising their two young sons. Christina later opened up and called it a really difficult time. Married back in 2008, they built an empire and a family, and now they are taking different paths while staying a team for their kids.
